name: tendsto_lintegral_thickenedIndicator_of_isClosed
statement: Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [PseudoEMetricSpace Ω] [OpensMeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {F : Set Ω} (F_closed : IsClosed F) {δs : ℕ → ℝ} (δs_pos : ∀ n, 0 < δs n) (δs_lim : Tendsto δs atTop (𝓝 0)) : Tendsto (fun n ↦ lintegral μ fun ω ↦ (thickenedIndicator (δs_pos n) F ω : ℝ≥0∞)) atTop (𝓝 (μ F))

name: tendsto_integral_thickenedIndicator_of_isClosed
statement: Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [PseudoEMetricSpace Ω] [OpensMeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {F : Set Ω} (F_closed : IsClosed F) {δs : ℕ → ℝ} (δs_pos : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < δs n) (δs_lim : Tendsto δs atTop (𝓝 0)) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ ∫ ω, (thickenedIndicator (δs_pos n) F ω : ℝ) ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (μ.real F))

name: measure_isClosed_eq_of_forall_lintegral_eq_of_isFiniteMeasure
